@syntax ElseIf condition
@syntax Else If condition
Another condition for the block form of [If](If), tested only when the conditions before it were false. `Else If` written as two words means the same.

```blitzbasic
;run
n = 15
If n < 10
	Print "small"
ElseIf n < 20
	Print "medium"
Else If n < 30
	Print "large"
EndIf
```

```text
medium
```
